seo.title: Maras & Moray ATV Tour Full Day from Cusco
seo.description: Explore Maras and Moray by ATV while enjoying Andean scenery, culture, and nearby archaeological sites in Cusco.

summary: Explore Maras and Moray by ATV while enjoying Andean scenery, culture, and nearby archaeological sites in Cusco.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Salineras, Maras, Moray by quad bike (duration: 7 hours) – in a group
itinerary.body: In the morning, at an agreed time, we will pick you up from your hotel in Cusco, we will take a van trip of approximately 1h20m, until we arrive at our camp called, “CRUZPATA”, located in the northwest of the city of Cusco, in this place our adventure will begin After a safety briefing, explanation of ATVs operation we will also have enough time to practice ATVs. Our professional guides will provide you with additional information and complete equipment such as helmet and gloves. We will start our tour to Moray on a route with beautiful landscapes, the route is 27 km round trip and complete return, we will have a guided visit to the archaeological center of Moray and enough time to visit it, then we will return to our base in Cruzpata, this route It has one of the best views of the Urubamba mountain range, approximately 2 hours of ATV driving. Once at our base, we will leave the quad bikes at our base and go on our private transport to the Maras salt mines, located 15 minutes away on our transport.
